tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (was --bg).

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: receipt identifiers, skeleton fills, track of progress bars.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Primary surface: timeline cards, forms, chat bubbles from the assistant (was --surface).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: receipt blocks, table stripes, inline forms inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elevated surface: menus, sheets, sticky contribute bar. Always paired with shadow-1 or shadow-2.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg-page, surface, surface-2, surface-raised and every status-*-bg (was --ink).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy (meta lines, descriptions) on bg-page, surface, surface-2.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, captions, placeholder-level hints on bg-page, surface, surface-2. Never for essential instructions (was --muted).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and status-confirmed-solid fills.

tokens.name: text-on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary fills.

tokens.name: text-on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on critical fills (destructive button).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control (was --line).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons) and the timeline thread. 3:1 on surface and bg-page.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand teal. Primary buttons, links, selected states, the confirmed-delivery segments (was --a).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item background.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg-page, surface, surface-2.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Restrained indigo. The record layer (filings, receipts) and the focus ring (was --b).

tokens.name: secondary-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of record-layer callouts and the technical-details disclosure.

tokens.name: funding
tokens.usage: Fill of the funding bar. Money is drawn in ink, never in a status colour.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Overlay tint for hover on quiet controls and rows.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Overlay tint for pressed quiet controls and rows.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Disabled control label. Exempt from contrast minimums; never the only cue.

tokens.name: disabled-border
tokens.usage: Disabled control boundary.

tokens.name: status-neutral-text
tokens.usage: Label text of neutral states (Pending, Not started, Deposit held) on status-neutral-bg, surface, bg-page.

tokens.name: status-neutral-icon
tokens.usage: Icon of neutral states.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Badge and banner fill for neutral states.

tokens.name: status-neutral-border
tokens.usage: Badge and banner outline for neutral states.

tokens.name: status-record-text
tokens.usage: Label text of the record layer (Receipt matched, Recorded) on status-record-bg, surface, bg-page.

tokens.name: status-record-icon
tokens.usage: Icon of the record layer.

tokens.name: status-record-bg
tokens.usage: Badge fill for the record layer.

tokens.name: status-record-border
tokens.usage: Badge outline for the record layer.

tokens.name: status-progress-text
tokens.usage: Label text of In progress and Uploading on status-progress-bg, surface, bg-page.

tokens.name: status-progress-icon

tokens.name: status-progress-bg

tokens.name: status-progress-border

tokens.name: status-confirmed-border

tokens.name: status-confirmed-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fill reserved for the Confirmed milestone badge and confirmed delivery segments. Text on it: text-on-accent.

tokens.name: status-attention-text
tokens.usage: Label text of Incomplete, Refund outstanding, Upload failed on status-attention-bg, surface, bg-page (was --c).

tokens.name: status-attention-icon
tokens.usage: Icon of attention states.

tokens.name: status-attention-bg
tokens.usage: Fill for attention states.

tokens.name: status-attention-border
tokens.usage: Outline for attention states.

tokens.name: status-critical-text
tokens.usage: Label text of Flagged, Overdue, Declined on status-critical-bg, surface, bg-page (was --warn).

tokens.name: status-critical-icon
tokens.usage: Icon of critical states; the overdue marker on the delivery track.

tokens.name: status-critical-bg
tokens.usage: Fill for critical badges and banners.

tokens.name: status-critical-border
tokens.usage: Outline for critical badges and banners.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill. Text on it: text-on-critical.

tokens.name: critical-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover.
